question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses list female figures who know through devotion on earth.
This verse names ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī as further figures.
The particles vā and tathā mark these figures as alternatives included in the same category.
inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sararī-woman, and gūlī-woman are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identity or nature of sararī and gūlī is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Likewise, the owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman.
